description: sheets.spreadsheets.get: GET v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}. Returns the spreadsheet at the given ID. The caller must specify the spreadsheet ID. By default, data within grids is not returned. You can include grid data in one of 2 ways: Specify a field mask listing your desired fields using the fields URL parameter in HTTP Set the includeGridData URL parameter to true. If a field mask is set, the includeGridData parameter is ignored For large spreadsheets, as a best practice, retrieve only the specific spreadsheet fields that you want. Runs as a background job; completion preserves the vendor response and names the selected account. key, access_token and oauth_token are refused: the connected account authenticates. Parameters use exact vendor names. See editors_api_coverage.md for scopes, bodies and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Sheets Spreadsheets Get to returns the spreadsheet at the given ID in Google Sheets, as the selected connected Google account (GET v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}). Returns Google's full response.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued; completion includes account, method, full vendor response and response headers.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the account that answered and the identifiers the caller needs next.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return one short message through the active IO plugin.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params names the argument or body field and the vendor rule it broke, including refused key/access_token/oauth_token; gsuite.unknown_account names connected accounts; gsuite.missing_scope requires reconnect; gsuite.auth_expired includes Testing-mode renewal guidance; gsuite.permission_denied, gsuite.not_found and gsuite.rate_limited preserve vendor messages.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the named vendor field, choose a connected account, or reconnect with start_interface and connect_account to approve missing scopes. Retry rate limits later.
